lead.why: Among all tested compounds, 60 emerged as a potent and photochemically stable neuronal Kv7 channel activator (abstract).

reactions.conditions: DIPEA (1.2 equiv), catalytic I2, DMF, 170 C, 4 h (SNAr of the fluorine para to the nitro group); 81% yield.
reactions.source: Experimental section, compound 58 (main text, text of Scheme 4); the procedure text says 'giving intermediate 65' which is a typo for 58 (65 is a different compound).

reactions.conditions: General procedure H, one pot: Zn (5 equiv), NH4Cl (5 equiv), MeOH, rt until nitro consumed; then acyl chloride (1.2 equiv) and DIPEA (1.2 equiv), rt, 45 min; 66% yield. Acylation is on the nitrogen derived from the nitro group.
reactions.source: Experimental section, compound 60 and General Procedure H (main text).

notes: Printed name of 58 (1,3-diamine, F at 2, NO2 at 4, benzyl on N1) is consistent with SNAr displacement of the F para to NO2 in 2,3-difluoro-6-nitroaniline. Zn/NH4Cl reduction and acylation are reported as ONE procedure (H), counted as one step; the intermediate triamine is not isolated. The acyl chloride is not explicitly stated as purchased, but the General section says all reagents were purchased from Sigma-Aldrich unless noted.
